topic: Complex Numeric Literal Representations and Type Safety in C
explanation: In advanced C programming, understanding and correctly utilizing various numeric literal representations—such as decimal, octal, and hexadecimal—is crucial for low-level programming, bit manipulation, and ensuring type safety. Proper use of these literals allows for precise control over data, memory addresses, and hardware interfacing, while also avoiding common pitfalls like unintended value interpretation or overflow. Mastery of this concept enables developers to write more efficient, portable, and reliable code when dealing with hardware registers, bitfields, or embedded systems.
keywords: C numeric literals, literal suffixes, hexadecimal literals
